Perseid meteor shower and summer stargazing event. Held at Nora Naguri, a glamping facility. A certified Star Sommelier® will guide you using binoculars and telescopes to observe meteors, the Summer Triangle, the Milky Way, and more.

【Date and Time】
Wednesday, August 12, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 7:00 p.m.–8:30 p.m.
Reception: 6:30 p.m. onwards
Assembly: 6:50 p.m.
Rain date: Thursday, August 13, 2026

【Venue】
Nora Naguri
607-1 Shimo-Naguri, Hanno, Saitama Prefecture

【Fees】
Adults: ¥1,000
Elementary school children and under: ¥500
Preschoolers: Free

【Capacity and Registration】
First come, first served. Maximum 20 participants. Advance registration required.

【What to Bring】
Drink, leisure sheet or folding chair

【Weather and Postponements】
If the weather is poor, cancellation or postponement will be decided by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the event and communicated by email.

For more information and to register, visit the Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association website (link in source).
summary: 🎪 Hanno Naguri stargazing event! Watch the Perseid meteor shower and summer constellations.
